cross_references.note: §11513 violations are the predicate for §1094.5(b) fair trial challenges. Each §11513 protection — oath, cross-examination, hearsay limitation — corresponds to a specific ground for relief on mandamus. §11513 defines what a fair trial requires; §1094.5 enforces it.

§11513(d): hearsay not sufficient alone for a finding unless civilly admissible. Whether a police report or business record qualifies as civilly admissible hearsay (EVID §1271 business records; EVID §1280 official records) determines whether it can be the sole basis for an APA finding.

CalVCB A25-10117946 single-source denial: §11513(d) bars a finding based solely on the police report (hearsay, no independent civil exception established) if timely objected. This is the evidentiary foundation of the §1094.5 mandamus petition.

PC §1368 competency proceedings in OAH format: §11513(b) cross-examination right applies. Was Dr. Wiita cross-examined on the absence of MC-350 and the foundation for her evaluation? §11513(a) oath: was her testimony sworn?
GOV §11340 APA purpose establishes the regulatory framework GOV §11513 procedurally implements. §11340 is the why; §11513 is the how. Both are required for understanding the APA hearing system.
